content: In our experiments, we tune model parameters on the development set and report results on the test set. We design experiments from both ranking-based direction and question generation-based direction. The evaluation metric is precision @1 BIBREF17 , which indicates whether the top ranked result is the correct answer. We further report BLEU score BIBREF27 for the question generation approach.
